parameters.content:
## 1 - Watch
Surfline's `kbyg` endpoint is public: no key, no relay.
It *is* behind Cloudflare though, which 403s a default API-client
User-Agent - hence the browser UA header on both nodes. That is almost
certainly why other builds proxy this through r.jina.ai.

Every tunable lives in **Config**, so no threshold is ever buried in a
Code node. Swap `spotId` for your break (it's in the surfline.com URL);
the timezone follows automatically from the API response.

## 2 - Only once per swell
The forecast stays good for ~12 consecutive runs.
**Claim this swell** hashes the swell into a stable `eventKey` and
records it *before* anything costs money.

This is the single biggest thing missing from most versions of this idea.

## 3 - Price it
Amadeus free tier, real API, no scraper and no per-run charge.
Credentials live in a **Custom Auth** credential, never in this file.

`Search flights` continues on error on purpose: a fare outage should
still let the proposal go out, just without prices.

## 4 - The real gate
`sendAndWait` genuinely suspends the execution until a
human taps a button. It cannot be faked by a Code node returning true,
which is exactly why it is the right primitive here.

No approval within 12h and it resumes down the decline branch.
